description: Defines the IcmpReachable class for ICMPv6 reachability testing within the quic namespace, including related interfaces, enums, and internal classes.

classes.name: IcmpReachable
classes.description: Manages ICMPv6 reachability checks by sending Echo Requests and handling responses, errors, and timeouts.

classes.name: IcmpReachable::StatsInterface
classes.description: Interface for receiving callbacks about reachability events, errors, and statistics.

classes.name: IcmpReachable::EpollCallback
classes.description: Handles socket events for ICMP communication.

classes.name: IcmpReachable::AlarmCallback
classes.description: Handles alarm events for scheduling ICMP Echo Requests.

methods.name: IcmpReachable
methods.description: Constructor initializing reachability probe with source/destination addresses, timeout, kernel, event loop, and stats interface.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the reachability probe, must be called from the epoll server thread.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Handles alarm events to send ICMP Echo Requests.

methods.name: StatusName
methods.description: Returns string representation of the Status enum.

methods.name: OnSocketEvent
methods.description: Handles socket events for ICMP communication.

methods.name: OnAlarm
methods.description: Callback for alarm events to trigger ICMP requests.
